name: Vermont

jury_list.holder: Superior Court clerks; questionnaire access is governed by Court Administrator rules (4 V.S.A. 955).

sources.cite: 4 V.S.A. 955 (Court Administrator rules govern inspection of juror questionnaires)

voter_file.who_may_get: The checklist is a public record except confidential fields (17 V.S.A. 2154(b)(1)).

private_challenge.who: At the polls, party, candidate, and ballot-committee representatives may challenge a person on the checklist only on identity or prior voting in the same election (17 V.S.A. 2564). The board of civil authority reviews eligibility (17 V.S.A. 2150). No private pre-election challenge was found.

state_windows.applies_to: Systematic removal programs by the board of civil authority
state_windows.effect: Any systematic program for removing names must be completed at least 90 days before an election.

county_board.name: Vermont town clerks (Secretary of State)
county_board.note: Vermont runs checklists by town; the board of civil authority decides removals (17 V.S.A. 2150).

state_election_office.name: Vermont Secretary of State - Elections Division

gates.basis: Jury records: status unknown (null), so counts only. Polling-place challenges cannot raise citizenship (17 V.S.A. 2564). Strict gates.

notes: Month and day of birth are confidential (17 V.S.A. 2154(b)(1)), so dob_in_public_file is false.
17 V.S.A. 2154(b)(2) bars public agencies from giving full checklists to foreign governments or federal agencies; it does not address private requesters.
